response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rented_films FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_shares AS (SELECT rating, rented_films, CAST(rented_films AS DECIMAL(38,20)) / SUM(rented_films) OVER () AS share FROM rating_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM rating_shares) SELECT SUM(rs.rented_films) AS combined_rented_films, AVG(rs.share) AS average_share, AVG(rs.share - b.average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM rating_shares AS rs CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE rs.share > b.average_share

assumptions.assumption: Each linked rental counts once; the average share is the arithmetic mean across ratings represented in those rentals.
